title: Spring Core & IoC
intro: Spring Core interview questions test whether you understand the framework underneath Spring Boot — the IoC container, dependency injection (constructor vs setter vs field), bean lifecycles and scopes, the BeanFactory vs ApplicationContext, AOP fundamentals (proxies, advices, pointcuts), and the @Transactional internals interviewers love to probe. This page covers the conceptual layer that lets you debug a real Spring app instead of just write one. Pair this page with the Spring Boot page (auto-configuration, starters, profiles), Spring Data JPA / Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring WebFlux, and Spring Batch.
